Our Services

At Lumina Architects, we blend contemporary design with functional excellence. Discover how we transform spaces and ideas into timeless architectural solutions.

What We Offer

Architectural Design

From initial concept to detailed drawings, we create innovative designs that balance aesthetics with functionality. Our team specializes in residential, commercial, and mixed-use projects.

Planning & Permitting

Navigate complex building codes and regulations with confidence. We handle all planning documentation and coordinate with local authorities to ensure smooth project approval.

Renovation & Restoration

Breathe new life into existing structures. Whether modernizing a heritage building or updating a dated space, we preserve character while enhancing performance and design.

Interior Architecture

Shape the spaces within. Our interior design approach ensures layouts, materials, and finishes create cohesive, beautiful environments tailored to how you live and work.

Project Management

From construction oversight to quality control, we manage every detail. Our team ensures projects stay on schedule, within budget, and built to specification.

Consultation & Feasibility

Unsure if your vision is possible? We provide expert consultation on project viability, cost estimates, and design direction before committing to full design services.

Our Design Process

We follow a structured, collaborative approach to bring your vision to life:

01

Discovery & Consultation

We listen to your goals, constraints, and dreams. Through interviews and site visits, we gather all information needed to inform our design direction.

02

Concept Development

Our team creates initial sketches and concept designs exploring different approaches. You'll see multiple directions before we settle on the best path forward.

03

Design Development

We refine the chosen concept with detailed drawings, materials selection, and technical specifications. This phase ensures every element is carefully considered.

04

Documentation & Permits

Complete construction documents and technical drawings are prepared. We handle all permitting and coordination with building authorities and consultants.

05

Construction Administration

Our architects oversee construction, answer contractor questions, and inspect work. Regular site visits ensure quality and adherence to design intent.

06

Project Completion

Final walk-through and punch-list completion. We ensure everything is finished to specification and your space is ready to be enjoyed.

Ready to Start Your Project?

Let's discuss your vision and explore how Lumina Architects can bring it to life.

Meet Our Team

A collective of architects, designers, and creative thinkers dedicated to crafting timeless spaces.

Our Architects & Designers

Sofia Mendez

Principal Architect & Founder

With over 15 years of experience in contemporary architecture, Sofia founded Lumina Architects to bring visionary design to every project. Her work has been featured in international design publications.

Marcus Chen

Senior Architect

Marcus specializes in sustainable design and urban planning. His expertise in green building certification has helped clients achieve LEED and Passive House standards on multiple projects.

Elena Rodriguez

Lead Interior Designer

Elena brings spaces to life through thoughtful material selection and spatial planning. Her background in art history informs her unique approach to blending heritage with modern aesthetics.

David Park

Project Architect

David manages all phases of project development with meticulous attention to detail. His background in computational design pushes the boundaries of what's possible in contemporary architecture.

Priya Kapoor

3D Visualization Specialist

Priya creates immersive renderings and visualizations that help clients envision their projects. Her technical skills in BIM and photorealistic modeling bridge design intent and client communication.

James Whitley

Studio Manager

James ensures every project runs smoothly from conception to completion. His project management expertise and client relations keep Lumina Architects organized and our clients satisfied.

Our Values

Innovation

We embrace new technologies and creative thinking to push the boundaries of contemporary design and create spaces that inspire.

Sustainability

Every project is designed with environmental responsibility at its core, balancing aesthetics with ecological impact and long-term durability.

Collaboration

We work closely with clients, consultants, and contractors, fostering open dialogue to ensure every vision is realized with integrity.

Timelessness

Rather than chasing trends, we design spaces that endure—buildings and interiors that remain relevant and beautiful for generations.

Ready to Work Together?

Get in touch with our team to discuss your next architectural project.
